keyEvents.text: Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Gabriel Gudmundsson (Leeds United) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Andrey Santos (Manchester United).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Leeds United 0, Manchester United 1. Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Youri Tielemans with a cross.
First Half ends, Leeds United 0, Manchester United 1.
Substitution, Manchester United. Noussair Mazraoui replaces Lisandro Martínez.

Goal! Leeds United 1, Manchester United 1. Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Leeds United) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Tarik Muharemovic following a corner.
Delay in match because of an injury Amad Diallo (Manchester United).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Leeds United. Lukas Nmecha replaces Noah Okafor.
Substitution, Manchester United. Mason Mount replaces Carlos Baleba.
Substitution, Leeds United. Sean Longstaff replaces Ao Tanaka.
Substitution, Manchester United. Matheus Cunha replaces Youri Tielemans.
Ethan Ampadu (Leeds United) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Andrey Santos (Manchester United) is shown the yellow card.
Second Half ends, Leeds United 1, Manchester United 1.
